name: Rape Aikoukai
source:
Three guys dedicated to the hobby of forceful love.
One might call them a gang. In any case, they are enthusiasts.
Today they're looking to trap another solitary girl.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184229.html]DLsite English[/url]]

三个致力于强烈爱情爱好的家伙。
人们可以称他们为一伙。无论如何，他们都是爱好者。
今天他们想要诱捕另一个孤独的女孩。
